preconditions.description: k must be between 1 and n, inclusive, and n must be between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The returned value must be an integer between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sorted(range(1, n+1), key=lambda x: str(x))[k-1]
postconditions.description: The returned value must be the k-th smallest integer in lexicographical order from 1 to n.
